sla_onsite.text: of Interest National Reactor Innovation Center (NRIC), Idaho National Laboratory (INL) 1. INTRODUCTION Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (BEA), the Management and Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is seeking an Expression of Interest (EOI) from qualified software development vendors capable of providing backend software engineering, integration, and documentation support for the National Reactor Innovation Center’s (NRIC) ARIES nuclear design and safety-basis platform. ARIES is a prototype-first digital platform supporting advanced reactor demonstration projects by translating DOE licensing and safety guidance into a structured, navigable, multi-module software system. 2. BACKGROUND INL is a U.S. Department of Energy national laboratory dedicated to nuclear energy, national security, and clean energy innovation.
